The phrase is Italian for "and yet, it moves", and is attributed to the astronomer [[Galileo Galilei]], when forced by the [[Roman Inquisition]] to denounce his belief in [[heliocentrism]].<ref name="prod1"/> The episode's gulag scenes were inspired by [[Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn]]'s works ''[[The Gulag Archipelago]]'' (1973) and ''[[One Day in the Life of Ivan Denisovich]]''

2Shy.production: "2Shy" was written by [[Jeff Vlaming]], who had previously worked for the series ''[[Weird Science (TV series)|Weird Science]]''. Vlaming's only other writing credit for the series was the later third-season episode "[[Hell Money]]".<ref>Lovece, p. 239</ref> He had initially pitched the idea of a mutant who fed on body oils, which was eventually changed to body fats.
